_comment: Single source of truth for EC2 on-demand pricing used to derive cost-per-token / cost-per-task. Verified from the AWS Price List API (pricing:GetProducts / bulk offer file), us-east-1, Linux, shared tenancy, on-demand. Update dollars_per_hour here and regenerate the throughput summaries + README chart; do not hardcode prices in scripts. A model served at TP < gpus_per_instance uses only a fraction of the box, so its effective rate is dollars_per_hour * tp / gpus_per_instance (see pricing.py resolve()).
